words.example: Please sign the time sheet before you go home on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 周五回家之前，请在工时表上签字。

words.example: Hours worked last week include two night shifts and one Sunday.
words.exampleZh: 上周的实际工时包括两个夜班和一个星期日。

words.example: The core team meets for fifteen minutes at the start of each morning.
words.exampleZh: 核心团队每天早晨开十五分钟的会。

words.example: The extended team joins the meeting only when we need them.
words.exampleZh: 只有我们需要的时候，扩展团队才来参加会议。

words.example: The project team will show the new calling screen on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 项目组周五会展示新的叫号屏。

words.example: Each stripe spreads one write across all six disks in the imaging set.
words.exampleZh: 每一条条带都把一次写入分到影像组的六块盘上。

words.example: The mirror still has a full copy, so the array survived the loss of disk two.
words.exampleZh: 镜像盘上还有完整副本，所以丢了二号盘阵列也撑住了。

words.example: Parity on this set can rebuild one missing disk, but not two at once.
words.exampleZh: 这组盘的校验能重建一块丢失的盘，不能同时重建两块。

words.meaning: 镜像阵列（Redundant Array of Independent Disks）
words.example: RAID 1 keeps a second copy of the database logs on the paired disk.
words.exampleZh: 镜像阵列在配对盘上留着数据库日志的第二份。

words.meaning: 校验阵列（Redundant Array of Independent Disks）
words.example: RAID 5 on the file server can lose one disk and still serve the ward shares.
words.exampleZh: 文件服务器上的校验阵列可以坏一块盘，病区共享仍然能用。
